acceptance_checks.expected: The registered decision packet, executable verification receipt, and manifest retain their recorded SHA-256 values.
The target remains at version 1.0.0 and its registered hash before any manual application.
Two runs from the same registered inputs produce byte-identical proposal artifacts.
After approval and manual application, exactly one instruction is appended under the feedback gate.

feedback_summary: Require replay of the bound executable control receipt before a feedback-derived process policy patch can be manually accepted.
non_goals: Do not create or strengthen any scientific claim from this preference event.
Do not bypass, disable, or weaken any verifier or evidence gate.
Do not modify a prompt, skill, schema, verifier, or registry automatically.
Do not treat a bound control receipt as scientific success or human acceptance.

provenance_checks.detail: Packet, receipt, manifest identities and hashes match the control-source registry.
The decision packet, executable receipt, and manifest resolve within the repository.
The manifest binds the packet and the packet binds the exact replayed executable receipt.
Structural, integrity, and executable verification passed while human acceptance remains pending.
The source authorizes only an unapplied process proposal and no scientific conclusion.
Candidate bytes and canonical object digest match the registry and decision packet.
Every current repository-local evidence artifact matches its receipt-bound SHA-256.
Verifier identity, command, artifact path, and current artifact hash match the trusted registration.
The currently registered executable verifier passed over the bound candidate and reproduced the receipt output.
A fresh evaluation reproduced the complete registered decision packet while human acceptance remained pending.
Target path, type, current version, and SHA-256 match the registry.
One process-only instruction targets one location and one patch version.
Required acceptance checks and exact rollback bytes are declared.

rollback_rule.action: Restore the registered target bytes and replay the bound executable control verifier before reconsideration.
rollback_rule.trigger: Any declared acceptance check fails after a human-approved manual application.

single_change.proposed_value: Before any manual application, replay the registered executable control verifier and revalidate the bound packet, receipt, and manifest hashes; reject the proposal if any binding changes.
single_change.rationale: The explicit user preference asks for replayable control-source linkage before any workflow policy proposal is manually applied.
